notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch) sufficed throughout. robots.txt (https://www.homecentre.in/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow; general disallows (/in/en/search, /cart, /my-account, /in/c/*, /in/en/*/c/* etc.) do not cover the /in/en/c/<slug> category URLs used here. Fetched sitemapindex.xml -> 15 sub-sitemaps (appliances, toppages, livingroom, refurbished, kitchen, customizedfurniture, blog, decor, gifts, diningroom, sitemap_1 (PDP-only), bedroom, homeoffice, outdoor, bathandlaundry, furnishing) and grepped every one for holiday/festival keywords (christmas, diwali, halloween, easter, newyear, holi, rakhi, raksha, eid, thanksgiving, festiv, valentine, xmas, santa, ganesh, occasion). Only gifts.xml carried genuine seasonal/holiday category nodes; decor.xml's only religious-figurine categories (Ganesha/Buddha/Krishna/Lakshmi/Radha-Krishna idols) are permanent decor lines, not holiday-specific PLPs, so excluded per boundary rule 5-6. All 8 department root sitemaps confirmed present with no additional festival branch. Homepage SSR HTML was checked for extra nav links (client-hydrated mega menu not present in SSR payload, so no additional discovery there) plus one embedded promo banner: a 'Diwali' homepage banner links to /sis/clearancesale -> excluded as storewide clearance-sale page, not a genuine category (confirms boundary rule against Diwali Sale pages). Verified all 10 candidate PLPs are genuine, curated categories -- not auto-generated alias pages -- by requesting a nonsense sibling slug (gifts-specialoccasiongifts-nonsensezzzday), which returned HTTP 302 (redirect/reject) versus HTTP 200 for every real slug tested. Each real page was checked for: HTTP 200 + substantial SSR payload, breadcrumb trail (Gifting Store > Festive Gifts / Special Occasion Gifts), SEO-specific <title>, a real product grid (product-N tiles with distinct HOMECENTRE-* SKUs matching the occasion, e.g. Diwali page showing Ganesha figurines/diyas-adjacent decor/gifting items), and an exact qty via the page's embedded facet stats block ('stats':{'price':{'count':N}}), which is the structured per-category product count (verified distinct and non-identical across sibling categories, ruling out a shared fallback list). Two parent umbrella nodes exist in the taxonomy -- 'Festive Gifts' (gifts-festivegifts, 378 products) and 'Special Occasion Gifts' (gifts-specialoccasiongifts, 808 products) -- but each aggregates MULTIPLE DIFFERENT holidays/occasions (not subsets of one holiday), so per rules Section 9 (grouping rows apply only when children are subsets of the SAME holiday) these parents were excluded entirely rather than emitted as grouping rows; only their per-holiday children are recorded as leaf rows, each in its own holiday's 'category'. Diwali was checked with particular care per instructions: gifts-festivegifts-diwaligifts is a genuine, curated 23-product Diwali gifting PLP (title 'Buy Diwali Gifts 2026 Online at Low Prices From Home Centre') distinct from the excluded Diwali clearance-sale banner. Checked for Holi, Eid, Navratri, Dussehra, Onam, Pongal, Karwa Chauth, Makar Sankranti, Baisakhi, Janmashtami, Durga Puja, Independence Day, Black Friday, Thanksgiving, Halloween, Easter, St. Patrick's Day: none appear anywhere in any sitemap or on the pages inspected -- genuinely absent from this site's taxonomy, not merely unsearched. Mother's Day and Father's Day were evaluated under the same genuine-PLP test as every other holiday per explicit instruction and both pass (real curated PLPs, exact qty, SEO titles for Mother's Day; Father's Day shares the generic 'Special Occasion Gifts' <title> tag but still has its own distinct URL, breadcrumb, product grid and a facet-count of 179 clearly different from its siblings, confirming it is a real filtered category, not a fallback page). Friendship Day and Women's Day gift pages were likewise found as distinct, real curated PLPs (Women's Day has an occasion-specific SEO title; Friendship Day shares the generic 'Special Occasion Gifts' title but has its own slug, breadcrumb and a distinct facet count of 286) and are included as genuine annual seasonal/gifting occasions per the 'and any other genuine seasonal/holiday category that appears in the site's own taxonomy' clause -- flagged for reviewer awareness since they are not on the rules module's named list. Qty method used throughout: structured per-category facet stats count ('stats.price.count'), which is a true per-category product count derived from the site's own search/facet engine (not the top-of-page 'totalResults' field, which showed a stale placeholder 0 in the raw SSR payload before client hydration). No PDP crawling was performed beyond reading SKU-name strings already present in the fetched category-page HTML to sanity-check product relevance.
